static_audit_command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base = 'f8cae57d23e582d21ed1cc34c083f992c1dcf725'
old = Path('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2d3-before-force-pack-admission.py')
new = Path('tests/test_force_pack_admission.py')
a, b = ast.parse(old.read_bytes()), ast.parse(new.read_bytes())
assert old.read_bytes() == subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':tests/test_force_pack_admission.py'])
# Normalize only the two resolver seam lambdas; no other AST node is exempted.
for tree in (a, b):
    count = 0
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if (isinstance(node, ast.Call) and len(node.args) > 1
                and isinstance(node.args[0], ast.Constant)
                and node.args[0].value == 'orze.engine.phases.run_artifact_preflight'):
            fun = node.args[1]
            assert isinstance(fun, ast.Lambda)
            assert fun.args.kwarg is None if tree is a else fun.args.kwarg.arg == 'kwargs'
            fun.args.kwarg = None
            count += 1
    assert count == 2
assert ast.dump(a) == ast.dump(b)
asserts = [ast.dump(n) for n in ast.walk(b) if isinstance(n, ast.Assert)]
fixtures = {'path':str(new),'before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(new.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'unchanged_asserts':len(asserts),'full_AST_identical_after_exact_two_keyword_normalizations':True}
snapshots = {}
for name, path in {
 'before-force-pack-admission.py':'tests/test_force_pack_admission.py',
 'before-gpu-scope-audit.py':'src/orze/engine/gpu_scope_audit.py',
 'before-phases.py':'src/orze/engine/phases.py',
 'before-pre-script-failure-report.py':'src/orze/engine/pre_script_failure_report.py',
 'before-process-supervision.py':'src/orze/engine/process_supervision.py',
 'before-process.py':'src/orze/engine/process.py',
 'before-termination-hold.py':'src/orze/engine/termination_hold.py',
}.items():
    snapshot = Path('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2d3-'+name)
    assert snapshot.read_bytes() == subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+path])
    snapshots[str(snapshot)] = {'source':path,'commit':base,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(snapshot.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
new_tests = {}
for path in sorted(Path('tests').glob('*artifact_preflight*.py')):
    result = subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e',base+':'+str(path)],capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode == 0:
        continue
    raw=path.read_bytes(); tree=ast.parse(raw)
    dump='\n'.join(ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert))
    new_tests[str(path)]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'assert_count':sum(isinstance(n,ast.Assert) for n in ast.walk(tree)), 'assert_AST_sha256':hashlib.sha256(dump.encode()).hexdigest()}
assert len(new_tests)==7
for path in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','--','tests']).decode().splitlines():
    assert path == str(new), path
print(json.dumps({'fixture_migration':fixtures,'fixed_baseline_snapshots':snapshots,'new_tests':new_tests},indent=2))
PY
